overall_summary: Data volume is relatively low with most videos gathering minimal views, though specific themes around 'self respect' (specifically deleting chats, unpinning names, and removing from lists) performed noticeably better (e.g., 41 views on AfaLxMy6FMY and rwOUYo_hayQ). Confidence is low, requiring a mix of repeatable action-oriented self-respect themes paired with controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'स्टेटस लिस्ट में सबसे ऊपर उन्हीं का नाम था' (rwOUYo_hayQ) and 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' (AfaLxMy6FMY) achieved the highest views (41).
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on micro-actions related to letting go on smartphones (typing, deleting, unpinning).

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing heavily on abstract pain like 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी' (aUuNKfe7jm4) got very low views (6).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract emotional statements and anchor the content in hyper-specific, tangible everyday moments.
